question: How does a command become events and a snapshot in packages/domain?
diagram:
flowchart LR
  subgraph test["thread.expect.test.ts"]
    EX["expectDecider · given · when"]
    CMD["ResolveThread"]
  end
  subgraph dom["packages/domain · thread/decider.ts"]
    EV["evolve(state, event)"]
    DE["decide(state, command, ctx)"]
    EVS["ThreadResolved · DecisionRecorded"]
    PJ["project(events) · PlanView"]
  end
  subgraph harness["kernel.ts · expect harness"]
    SNAP["__expect__/*.snap.txt"]
  end
  subgraph sch["packages/schema"]
    S["Id · ParticipantId · Text"]
  end
  EX -- "given events · replay" --> EV
  EV -- "state" --> DE
  CMD -- "when" --> DE
  DE -- "then" --> EVS
  EVS -- "fold" --> PJ
  EX -- "describeMessage · snapshot(name)" --> SNAP
  DE -- "zod" --> S

steps.caption: A test gives a history, then sends one command.
evolve folds the given events into the current state and holds no rules.
decide checks the flag and the state, then returns events or a rejection.
ResolveThread yields two facts, ThreadResolved and then DecisionRecorded.
project folds the stored events into the PlanView the api returns.
expectDecider writes each run as prose, and a changed snapshot fails the test.
